Junior year, October— As part of the 
project, a short expedition to France was 
carried out.

Watching the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
right before my eyes... Overwhelmed by the 
sheer power of international races, I was 
reminded once more of the massive wall 
standing before those who aim for the 
world stage.

Even so, Mei Satake dedicated herself to 
the cause without flinching in the 
slightest. All for the sake of those who 
carry romantic dreams.

The gains from the overseas journey were 
immense. Though that grand stage still 
felt far away, she kept running toward it. 
The first Representative Exchange Race was 
fast approaching.
